headline: SpaceX and Tesla Explore Potential Merger Valuing Shared Bitcoin Holdings
summary: Independent committees at SpaceX and Tesla are assessing a potential merger that would unite more than 30,000 bitcoin.
why: SpaceX and Tesla are high-profile technology and automotive firms led by Elon Musk, holding significant corporate bitcoin reserves.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: A potential merger announcement involves independent committee assessments that could reshape corporate strategy and capital structure.

why_moved: Speculation and corporate disclosures regarding major tech consolidations directly affect market valuations and investor sentiment.
